chapter_title: The Seventh, concerning the Five Fathers
spiritual_reading:
There are successive principal origins in the Divine order, sufficient in number for a complete work of salvation, each brought forth in turn by directed influx; and the later has its life from the prior.

The first origin is the unbounded Divine Itself, blessed in the splendor of self-existent glory, without limit or measure, the first and sole source of all derivation, eternal in itself, present with the whole series of derived origins, prior to every state that has been and that will be.

From this Divine Itself proceeded three primary determinations. First went forth the universal spiritual principle that receives and bears Divine life as wisdom receptive of love, the first womb of formation, appearing as the initial manifestation from the inmost. Second went forth the Divine beloved principle of manifested intelligible glory, the honored outshining of Divine truth from the same source, made present as an object of mutual union. Third went forth the primary mediating and revealing principle, eldest in counsel and leading in interpretation, appearing as the first emissary of the inmost will toward all lower degrees.

This is the first origin, the first power, from whom the three great powers came forth; the root of every illumination and every true understanding. By these proceeds the subjugation of denial and falsity: they reduce its cravings to nothing, they establish victory in themselves as order restored, and they communicate that victory to all the heavenly societies that depend on their influx.

The second origin, proceeding from the first, is the chief mediating revelation as the living pattern of Divine rule in truths. From it, in like manner, went forth three powers.

One is the sustaining form of the Divine Human in fullness, the perfected spiritual humanity that supports all things in their order, the universal stability and blessing, the supreme ministry by which all lower receptions are upheld.

The second is the manifested Divine truth that saves, the glorious presence of the Lord as enlightening splendor, through whom eternal life is given.

The third is the pure wisdom of Divine truth as a virginal perception unmingled with falsity, which by the presence of its form removes the persuasive center of dominion from ruling evils and falsities, accomplishing the delight of Divine greatness by restoring order.

The third origin, proceeding from the second, is that same saving manifested Divine truth in its operative coming. From it also were called forth three further operations, in the same likeness of the prior order.

Among these, one is the great discriminating function that judges all human souls: the arrangement of spiritual equilibrium by which every person is weighed according to love and faith, established in the intermediate region where outer thought meets inner intention, under the general ordering of knowledges and their fixed patterns.

The fourth origin is the enlightened understanding from the Divine, which discerns and chooses all genuine assemblies of worship and doctrine. From it likewise proceeded three powers, according to the pattern of the saving manifestation.

The fifth origin is the Divine form of light presented as the personal reception of heaven for each one after the laying aside of the natural life: the appearance of one’s spiritual identity according to the implanted image of Divine truth given to the teaching function, together with the complete ministry of higher aids that attend that disclosure.

These are the successive principal origins, each derived from the prior, each appearing and being made manifest through the other, so that the Divine may descend by ordered degrees and be received according to every level of life.

fills.notes: Retained “Third Ambassador” as the oldest-layer function-name for the primary mediating revealer, matching the correspondential role: emissary from the inmost toward lower degrees.

The Judge’s dwelling is “in the atmosphere” (the intermediate region of equilibrium). Correspondentially it is ordered under fixed knowledges and their determinate forms; in this register that is expressed as the zodiacal governance: the twelve-fold ordering beneath which the wheel of the heavens and the stars are ranged.
Connects the cosmological series demanded by the spiritual sense: atmosphere under the twelve, under the wheel, and under the stars as fixed patterns of knowledges.

assessment: Most lacunae are trivial letter-restorations fixed by the surviving word-forms. The only substantial restoration is ¶14’s cosmological placement of the Judge; the correspondential constraints (equilibrium in the intermediate region under fixed patterned knowledges) support a twelvefold ordering (zodiac) followed by the wheel and the stars, but the exact phrasing remains moderately constrained rather than certain.
